text:
maya: Final checklist for Wed's launch workshop (11am PT). Quick run-through: Zoom config, recording, transcript/captions, clip prioritization, HubSpot lead routing, and a 3-email post-event nurture. Need owners for each item.

alex: I can own Zoom/recording config — will set cloud recording + alt host to kevin. Adding notes now.

sophie: I'll own transcript -> S3 + caption splits. Planning to run internal transcribe pipeline v2 after upload. Need S3 path + retention policy.

kevin: Confirming alt host. Zoom account = org-live@redwood.com. Question: enable "Only authenticated users"? That will block external registrants.

maya: No auth. Keep registration enabled + passcode. Remove waiting room for panelists. Passcode will be in greenroom doc. @kevin add co-hosts: alex, sophie, zane.

ops-bot: deploy: recording_rule created -> meeting_id:9876543210, cloud_recording:true, record_speaker_tracks:false

sophie: Transcribe job plan: post-upload run -> outputs: per-speaker SRT, full TXT transcript, chapter markers. Clips folder -> s3://redwood-marketing/launch-2026/assets. Retain 90 days.

maya: Clip priority: demos, benchmark highlights, CTAs. Tag timestamps in the clip sheet: tinyurl.com/launch-clips. Use transcript markers for clip boundaries.

alex: HubSpot mapping: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=launch-apr26. Lead owner rule: company contains "enterprise" -> AE queue; else nurture. Can we capture an extra field 'interested_feature' on registration?

sophie: Recommend also adding a short free-text: "Which integration matters most?" + a single-select 'model preference' field. Helps routing.

kevin: Zoom settings done: passcode set, co-hosts added, cloud recording enabled. Also enabled Zoom auto-transcription but we will overwrite with higher-quality internal transcript.

maya: Post-event email cadence: 1) immediate "thank you" + replay + CTA, 2) 48h clip highlight + case study (content owner = jon), 3) 7d follow-up w/ demo offer (sales touch). Owners: maya (overall), jon (content), AE team (sales follow).

jon: I can take email 2 content. Need 15s highlight + 60s demo clip. Who edits?

sophie: I'll mark priority clips in the sheet and do first-pass trims. If extra polish needed, hand off to video contractor.

maya: Analytics: replay link must include UTM -> fire event to Segment -> update HubSpot contact prop 'watched_replay' true. @alex please confirm webhook and event schema.

alex: Webhook ready. I'll push event mapping and provide sample payload in the sheet.

kevin: Greenroom notes: audio check @10:30, slides uploaded as PDF to chat, enable "record separate audio files" for backup. Also verify panelist names match Zoom profiles.

ops-bot: upload: recording 1758890200 uploaded -> s3://redwood-marketing/launch-2026/recordings/1758890200.mp4

sophie: Transcription started: job_id tx-1758890300. ETA ~25m. Will create SRTs and chapter file.

maya: Great — final ask: update the post-event triage sheet (owners + tags) within 6 hours of event end. I'll audit at 6pm PT. :thumbsup:

zane: Heads-up — I'll monitor live chat and capture top Qs in the sheet in real-time so we can feed FAQ into follow-up emails.

maya: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping #marketing-ops and @maya.
